dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: Uh-huh, of course they are! These are made from the best white iron alloys that money can buy. I guarantee you won't find their equal anywhere else!

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: And taking care of them's super simple. Forget water, all you need are a few drops of engine oil every now and then to keep them glossy and shiny! How's that for a bargain?
